title: Hand over a narrower token
goal: Service A needs service B to act, without sharing its own full-power token.
obstacle: Forwarding the caller token gives B everything A had.
control: The token service issues a new token for B only, with a smaller scope.

steps.title: Ask
steps.tell: A presents its token and names the audience it needs.
steps.say: A asks for a token for B, not B for A's token.
steps.why: The request names exactly who the new token is for.

steps.title: Narrow
steps.tell: The token service checks policy and issues a token for B only.
steps.say: The new token is smaller and aimed at one place.
steps.why: The original token never reaches B.
